# Agent Harness Benchmarks

Evidence-aware public inventory of agent harness benchmarks.

- Markdown digest: ./agent.md
- Structured catalog: ./catalog.json
- Research method: ./research.md
- Source audit: ./source-audit.json
- Sitemap: ./sitemap.xml
- Comparison links: append `?compare=id1,id2` (up to three stable IDs) to the human page.
- Localized READMEs: https://github.com/zeredy879/awesome-agent-harness-benchmarks#readme
- Human interface: ./index.html
